title: Topological states and flat bands induced by bound states in the continuum in a ladder-shaped one-dimensional photonic crystal
summary: One-dimensional crystals serve as a versatile platform for engineering nontrivial states, which can be easily explored in transport configurations. In this work, we analyze the properties of a periodic structure composed of an H-shaped unit cell, which forms a periodic ladder-shaped system. Using tight-binding models, group-theoretical considerations, and standard band topology, we uncover the influence of bound states in the continuum (BICs) and quasi-BICs formed in the original finite geometry on the creation of nontrivial band states.
